thesis: ASO is in a strong uptrend (close 69.32 above SMA20 62.51, SMA50 55.04 and SMA200 52.95; 63-day return +42%) with undemanding multiples (forward P/E 9.79) and is outside the lagging tech sectors. But it is extended (10.9% above SMA20, RSI 71.8), trades above the mean analyst target 62.37 after a Loop Capital downgrade, and reward/risk from the entry mid 67.7 to stop 61.3 and target 74.5 is only about 1.06, below the 1.5 minimum. The bull concedes the setup is marginal, so the bear wins on risk/reward: wait for a deeper pullback or a volume breakout above 71.29 before re-rating.
invalidation: A daily close below 60.74 (Nov 3 low), or back below the SMA20 (about 62.5) on rising volume, ends the uptrend thesis.
